title: Record GPT-6.2, background/Live, customer-owned ZDR storage, retirement, and incident contracts without provider adoption
problem: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 reasoning/replay contracts, discounted background execution with provider auto-retry and temporary storage, and GPT-Live voice/backend delegation. Anthropic introduced customer-owned EFS storage plus health webhooks and deprecated Opus 4.5. Decide whether to amend protocol law, migrate or adopt, record evidence only, or make no repository change.
baseline: Default routes are local-first. DALEOBANKS alone retains optional legacy OpenAI Chat Completions and embeddings. No GPT-6.2, background Responses, GPT-Live, Anthropic EFS, Opus 4.5 runtime, or Kimi provider route was found. Draft PR 105 section 7 already governs exact contracts, bound artifacts, leased state, canonical receipts, retries, data scope, cost, independent evaluation, and duplicate runtimes.

alternatives.name: Evidence-only update
alternatives.description: Add the dated packet and this deliberation; change no protocol text or runtime.
advantages: Preserves new replay, queue, voice, storage and retirement contracts
alternatives.revival_evidence: Selected because breaking replay semantics, provider auto-retry/temporary storage, customer-owned ZDR failure modes, and a hard retirement cross the materiality gate.

alternatives.name: Brief only
disadvantages: Loses durable evidence in the established provider-review lineage
alternatives.revival_evidence: Use for cycles without a breaking contract, hard deadline, material incident, direct exposure, or new data/runtime boundary.

alternatives.name: Vendor-specific protocol amendment
alternatives.description: Add named GPT-6.2, EFS and Live clauses.
disadvantages: Couples constitutional text to volatile products
alternatives.revival_evidence: A deterministic failure demonstrates an invariant missing from section 7.

alternatives.name: Immediate adoption or migration
alternatives.description: Move to GPT-6.2/Opus 5.5 or adopt background, Live or EFS now.
advantages: Could improve capability, price, latency, voice interaction or data custody
disadvantages: No direct route, need, account contract, data approval, benchmark, total-cost baseline or founder approval exists
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder-approved sandbox with pinned contracts, least privilege, independent acceptance, complete cost, data-flow proof and rollback.

alternatives.name: Provider-native authority and runtime
alternatives.description: Let provider reasoning, queues, sessions, storage, safety cases, retries and evaluators own collaboration state.
disadvantages: Violates canonical authority, one-source-of-truth, evaluator independence and no-duplicate-runtime constraints
alternatives.revival_evidence: None while UNIIMENTE requires one canonical authority, task, receipt, evidence, cost and consequence plane.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Brief the user and leave PR 105 unchanged.
disadvantages: Loses durable replay, background, voice, EFS and retirement evidence

roles.position: Keep provider reasoning, queues, voice sessions, storage and safety workflows subordinate to human authority and one canonical machine.
material_concerns: Customer-owned storage must not become canonical evidence or authority
Provider delegation and auto-retry must not create a second runtime

roles.position: Bind every reasoning, queue, session, webhook and storage artifact to exact contracts, canonical attempts and receipts.
material_concerns: Prefix or identity changes can silently drop reasoning
Background retries and Live reconnects can duplicate work
Storage events can be delayed, missing or out of order

roles.position: Make no repository change because direct feature exposure is negative and section 7 already covers the invariants.
material_concerns: Five role prompts are one model's self-review
Official pages and beta behavior can change after capture
evidence_refs: Negative searches on four default branches

roles.position: Record contracts but deploy nothing until recovery, observability, isolation, cost and ownership are proven.
material_concerns: Queues, webhooks, voice sessions, buckets, IAM and KMS add operational failure planes
Discounts and zero-feature-price claims exclude material costs

roles.position: Treat reasoning, transcripts, sealed storage, status and cost data as bounded evidence requiring consent, privacy review and independent reconciliation.
material_concerns: Unreadable sealed blobs do not prove task correctness
Customer-owned storage does not cover all provider features or prove inference residency
Voice audio and delegation expand sensitive data scope
evidence_refs: Anthropic EFS overview and storage management
OpenAI Live and background data-control documentation

evidence.claim: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with breaking reasoning, tool, cache, parameter, region and tier contracts.
evidence.finding: Released 2026-11-17; no direct repository exposure found.

evidence.claim: OpenAI added discounted two-hour and eight-hour background completion windows with automatic eligible-capacity retries and temporary storage even under store:false or ZDR.
evidence.finding: Released 2026-11-17; no Responses background route found.

evidence.claim: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1.1 with voice/backend delegation and standby billing.
evidence.finding: Released 2026-11-19; no Live or voice route found.

evidence.claim: Anthropic released Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with customer-owned Sealed Safety Data and external-storage health webhooks.
evidence.finding: Released 2026-11-23; excluded surfaces, delayed/inconclusive health checks and unrecoverable-write risk apply; no integration found.

evidence.claim: Anthropic deprecated Claude Opus 4.5 for retirement on 2027-01-22.
evidence.finding: Announced 2026-11-23; no matching model or Anthropic adapter found.

evidence.claim: Material provider incidents occurred in the review window.
evidence.finding: OpenAI cost/model/conversation, Anthropic connector/model and Kimi API/model incidents were reported from 2026-11-18 through 2026-11-23; no affected direct route was found.

evidence.claim: Current default branches lack direct exposure to the material new features.
evidence.reference: GitHub exact searches at Kernel d64a6c93, DALEOBANKS 667439f4, WMI ec82b802, PumpStation db6758df on 2026-11-24
evidence.finding: DALEOBANKS retains optional gpt-4o-mini Chat Completions and text-embedding-3-small only; no new model, background, Live, EFS, Opus 4.5, Anthropic or Kimi route found.

counterevidence.claim: New constitutional protocol text is necessary.
counterevidence.finding: Existing provider-neutral rules cover every observed invariant.

counterevidence.claim: Official documentation proves UNIIMENTE or account behavior.
counterevidence.reference: No provider account, credential, storage bucket, invoice, contract, deployment or live call was accessed

pass_1.intended_outcome: Preserve one canonical, retry-safe, independently evaluated, privacy- and cost-bounded collaboration runtime while recording actionable reasoning, queue, voice, storage and retirement contracts.

advantages.statement: Dated evidence captures reasoning-drop, background auto-retry/temporary-storage, voice delegation, customer-owned ZDR storage and hard-retirement contracts.
advantages.amplified_value: Future owners can test or reject features from official contracts without adopting them now.

advantages.statement: Provider-neutral rules absorb changing models and storage products without constitutional churn.
advantages.amplified_value: Canonical authority remains stable across vendors, queues, sessions, buckets and webhook topologies.

disadvantages.statement: Another weekly record increases review debt.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Add two unique evidence files and one bounded PR-body delta only.

disadvantages.statement: The new provider features have no direct default-branch exposure.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Label exposure negative and defer code, deployment, storage and account action until authorized use exists.

disadvantages.statement: Dropped reasoning, provider auto-retries, reconnects and ambiguous errors can cause unsafe replay.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require exact artifact binding, original canonical idempotency identity, receipts and effect reconciliation before retry.

disadvantages.statement: Customer-owned storage and ZDR can be overclaimed as complete retention or inference residency.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Map excluded features and every storage/inference boundary; require independent object, IAM, key, retention and deletion checks.

disadvantages.statement: Model, queue, voice, storage and operational costs can be hidden by headline discounts or zero feature price.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require complete per-attempt and infrastructure total cost before any canary.

disadvantages.statement: One model's structured five-role review is not independent approval.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep draft status and require founder or delegated independent review.

comparisons.baseline: Local-first defaults, optional legacy OpenAI calls, no Anthropic/Kimi route, generic provider controls.
comparisons.do_nothing: Avoids review debt but loses durable replay, queue, voice, storage and retirement evidence.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: User brief only; lower burden but weak for the established evidence lineage and new data/runtime boundaries.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Provider reasoning, queues, voice, storage, safety cases, retries and evaluators own collaboration; convenient but incompatible with canonical authority and evaluator independence.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: If authorized, replay frozen prefix/drop, background, Live reconnect and storage-webhook fixtures offline, then run a cost-capped consequence-inert sandbox with independent acceptance.

rejected_alternatives.name: Add vendor-specific law
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A deterministic failure proves an uncovered invariant.

rejected_alternatives.name: Adopt or migrate now
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: No authorized route, need, account/storage contract, benchmark, total-cost review or founder approval exists.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Authorized need plus pinned fixtures, least privilege, independent evaluation, complete cost/data review and rollback.

rejected_alternatives.name: Inspect accounts, credentials or storage
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: This review lacks authority to access provider accounts, secrets, data-control settings, buckets, keys, invoices or contracts.

pass_2.attack_summary: The evidence-only design can become bureaucracy, overstate one-model review, rely on mutable beta pages, miss non-repository use, normalize provider state as authority, or let ZDR/storage branding disguise gaps and a second runtime.

new_weaknesses.statement: The recurring draft can become harder to review than the risk.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Keep this cycle to two evidence files and one body section; no protocol or code change.

new_weaknesses.statement: Reasoning artifacts, queues, voice sessions, buckets and safety cases can become vendor architectural dependencies.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Retain canonical tasks, receipts, evidence, costs and scheduler; forbid provider-owned authority or evaluation.

new_weaknesses.statement: Provider docs, beta headers, status, prices and health checks can change after capture.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Preserve dates, URLs and exact branch SHAs; require a fresh contract check before implementation.

new_weaknesses.statement: Long context, cache writes, background follow-ups, Live duration, tools, cloud storage, KMS, egress and incidents can hide total cost.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Require complete cost fixtures and kill adoption when any material cost is unavailable.

new_weaknesses.statement: Unreadable sealed data and delayed/missing storage events can create a false evidence-retention claim.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Require independent object arrival, IAM, key, retention, deletion and recovery evidence; never use sealed storage as task correctness proof.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Breaking replay/storage contracts and a hard retirement justify one evidence-only update.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Next cycle; brief-only unless materiality is met

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No adapter, deployment, storage configuration or migration is built until authorized exposure exists.
Existing exact-binding and receipt-gated recovery rules cover replay, reconnect and retry.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any prefix/model/user/organization change, queued request, reconnect, timeout or ambiguous state

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No ZDR, workspace, bucket, IAM, KMS, webhook, retention or residency claim is activated or changed.
Complete model, tool, infrastructure, storage, operational and correction cost is required before adoption.
Five roles are labelled self-review and cannot authorize adoption or merge.

pass_2.final_design: Add only the 2026-11-24 official-source evidence packet and validated deliberation to draft PR 105; leave section 7 and all runtime, routes, models, accounts, credentials, storage, production, authority and default branches unchanged.

residual_risks.mitigation: Require a separate authorized inventory before any migration or deadline.

residual_risks.risk: The deliberation is not independent approval.
residual_risks.mitigation: Keep draft status and require founder or delegated human decision.

residual_risks.risk: Provider contracts and health behavior can change after capture.
residual_risks.mitigation: Recheck official sources and pin fixtures before any canary.

dissent.handling: Preserve the brief-only objection. It controls scope: no protocol text, runtime code, fixture, provider call, account/storage inspection, model migration or activation. Breaking replay/storage contracts and a hard retirement justify only dated evidence.

entries.position: Make no repository change because direct feature exposure is negative and existing rules are sufficient.
entries.rationale: Recurring model-authored records can create bureaucracy and de facto policy authority.
entries.evidence_threshold: Future updates require direct exposure, a hard effective transition, breaking contract, material incident or uncovered authority/runtime/data invariant.
entries.review_trigger: Founder review or next weekly cycle

migration_plan: No runtime, model, voice or storage migration. If exposure is authorized, pin provider/model/API/prefix/user/organization/tier/region/cache/tool/queue/session/storage/IAM/KMS/retention contracts; map every operation, webhook, reconnect and retry into canonical attempts and receipts; prove drop, duplicate, delayed, missing, cancellation, restart, bucket failure, deletion and recovery with deterministic fixtures; perform independent evaluation and complete cost/privacy/security review; then run a founder-approved consequence-inert sandbox.

steps: Leave draft PR 105 unmerged or revert only the 2026-11-24 evidence commits
Preserve evidence and dissent as historical records
Return to brief-only reporting for immaterial cycles

kill_criteria: Any default-branch write or unapproved merge
Any account, credential, production, routing, model, voice, storage, spending or authority change
Any dropped reasoning treated as equivalent replay
Any background, Live or provider retry without receipt and idempotency reconciliation
Any ZDR or customer-owned storage claim used as inference-residency or complete-retention proof
Any provider queue, session, bucket, Safety Case, webhook, evaluator, evidence, cost, scheduler or runtime treated as canonical
Any missing model, tool, infrastructure, storage, operational or correction cost
review_trigger: Founder review of PR 105; any GPT-6.2, background, GPT-Live, EFS, Opus migration or provider incident with ambiguous completion, missing storage or delayed cost
